# Learn What You Need to Solve an Unfamiliar Problem

[← Amazon](../README.md) · [Every Amazon question](../../amazon.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/learn-what-you-need-to-solve-an-unfamiliar-problem)

---

Share a difficult problem that you started out unable to solve and explain how you acquired the knowledge to overcome it.

### Boundaries & Assumptions
Pick a genuine story and make clear what you personally contributed versus what the team did. This text supplies the question, not a candidate’s answer; the story examples in the solution section are invented.

### Questions to Clarify
Which concrete piece of knowledge did you lack?
How did you decide which materials or individuals to turn to?
What did you do to confirm your understanding through practical application?

### Elements of a Strong Response
A candid admission of what you didn’t know, a deliberate learning approach, hands-on tests or input from others, a finished application of the skill, and a lesson you carried forward.

### Potential Follow-ups
What did you initially misunderstand?
At what point did you realize you needed to seek help?
If you faced another unknown challenge, how would you tackle it differently?

Overview:
Describe how you learned by tackling an unfamiliar engineering problem, outlining the specific missing knowledge, the resources you chose, how you validated your understanding, feedback from experts, and the final application.

Read the full Amazon Software Engineer interview experience that this question is drawn from.
